:::{#thm-mvn-moments}
#### The mean and variance of the multivariate normal distribution

If $\vX \sim \Normal_p\paren{\vecf{\mean}, \matr{\covmat}}$ (@def-mvn),
then $\Expp\vX = \vecf{\mean}$
(the [expectation of a random vector](expectation.qmd#def-expectation-matrix)),
and $\Varf{\vX} = \matr{\covmat}$
(the [variance of a random vector](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cov-vec-x)).

:::
